name: gearbox
description: Per-prompt model and effort for Claude Code: Haiku sessions shift models, other sessions keep their model and get the right effort, tool-heavy work goes to cheap subagents, and a live readout shows every agent's model.

code_effort.title: Coding effort
code_effort.description: Effort for ordinary coding turns. Trivial turns still run low and the hardest ones xhigh; answers and explanations follow their difficulty. Anthropic advises medium for Opus 5.5.

steer.title: Steer sessions not on Haiku
steer.description: On sessions running another model, keep that model and set each turn's effort and handoffs. Off leaves those sessions alone apart from the readout.
